title: Pool asset order and ScVal map key order compared as strkey text instead of XDR bytes
severity_basis: A valid network transaction is refused by TransactionBuilder.fromXdr and the reversed pair yields the ID of a pool stellar-core cannot create; map keys are sorted out of host order. Fixed in 17.2.1; the asset-order half was backported to 16.3.1, the map-order half is not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: order by XDR bytes, as stellar-core and the host do
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0 and 17.2.0: getLiquidityPoolId throws 'Assets are not in lexicographic order' for a pair that is in XDR byte order (issuers compared as strkey text); 16.3.1 and 17.2.1 return the ID.

entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: nativeToScVal orders the keys 10, 9. The map-ordering half of the 17.2.1 fix is not on the 16.x line (the 16.3.1 backport covers asset order only).

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all) on js@16.3.0 and js@17.2.0 (asset order) and js@16.3.0 - 16.4.1 and js@17.2.0 (map order).
evidence.post_fix: js@17.2.1, js@17.3.0 and js@17.4.0 conform on the same entries.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-core orders the assets of a constant-product pool by XDR bytes (CAP-38) and the host orders ScMap keys by ScVal comparison (CAP-46).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 22 of 22 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0016.json.
